subject: How I can to do for insert big datasets in Shiny app?

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: How I can to do for insert big datasets in Shiny app?
parts:
I use a big matrix data set, example, matrix bigger than 100.000 columns. However, when I insert this matrix by the function fileInput( ) the system show me the error message: "Maximum upload size exceeded".

How I can to do for insert big datasets in Shiny app? 

In software R the insert matrix is normally for big datasets, but in Shiny I am not succeed it...!!!

Thanks for your attention.

messages.author: 37283d7785922c0c
messages.subject: Re: How I can to do for insert big datasets in Shiny app?
parts:
See Joe Cheng's post here:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!msg/shiny-discuss/rU3vwGMZexQ/zeKhiYXrtEQJ

Quoting:
"By default, Shiny limits file uploads to 5MB per file. You can modify this limit by using the shiny.maxRequestSize option. For example, adding options(shiny.maxRequestSize=30*1024^2) to the top of server.R would increase the limit to 30MB.
